en.meta-description: Resume of Yulibeth Rivero, Angular Frontend Developer with experience in Agile environments. Scalable, robust and accessible applications with UX principles.
en.home-description: Angular Frontend Developer with experience in Agile environments. Focused on building scalable, robust and accessible applications, applying UX principles. I use AI to support development and productivity.
en.about-me-description-1: Since 2016, I have been working in web development, evolving from layout and frontend roles to modern applications with Angular, TypeScript, and scalable architectures. I work with Angular 16+, developing reusable components, dynamic forms, state management with Angular Signals, REST API integration, unit testing, and UX/UI improvements in enterprise applications.
en.about-me-description-2: I have experience in DTO mapping, asynchronous programming with RxJS, testing, and collaboration using Git Flow and Azure DevOps. I also continue to deepen my knowledge of modern Angular, frontend architecture, and best development practices.
en.about-me-description-3:
I continue implementing improvements and new features in my personal projects to keep evolving technically:

• EZHub DS → Design System built with Angular. Available at EZHub DS.

• EZHub → room search application with geolocation (Angular + NestJS + MySQL). Available at EZHub.
en.about-me-description-4: I am currently seeking new opportunities as a Frontend Angular Developer, where I can contribute my experience in SPA development, code quality, and continuous learning.
en.tech-skills-description: In my career, I have worked with a variety of technologies, such as:
en.tech-skills-frontend-description: Interface development with Angular 16+ (Signals, Material), TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5, CSS3, SASS, JavaScript (ES6+), Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Jest, Jasmine/Karma, Vue and jQuery.
en.tech-skills-backend-description: Development and maintenance with REST APIs, Node.js, NestJS, MySQL, Oracle, Java and PHP.
en.tech-skills-design-description: Creating attractive and accessible interfaces with a focus on usability using Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe XD, InDesign and Figma.
en.tech-skills-others-description: Project management and version control with Scrum, Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps and Postman. GIS and Mapbox. AI prompting applied to code optimization and productivity.
en.soft-skills-description: I am autonomous, achievement- and customer-oriented, and I adapt well to change. I enjoy teamwork and collaborating to achieve common goals.
en.projects-ezhub-description: An application in development for room searches by geolocation, designed as the final project for my Angular bootcamp at IT Academy. The application interacts with the backend to manage users, properties, and rooms, and includes user authentication with JWT and password encryption. Built with Angular, Nest, MySQL, Mapbox, and TailwindCSS.
en.projects-ezhub-repositories: Repositories: Frontend | Backend
en.projects-ezhubds-description: Design System built with Angular focused on component reusability, scalability, and visual consistency in frontend applications. It includes reusable components, a styling system, modular architecture, and a strong focus on maintainability and user experience.
en.projects-ezhubds-repositories: Repository: Frontend
en.projects-ita-challenges-description: An application developed by IT Academy that enables students to participate in programming challenges and track their progress. In 2024, I actively collaborated by implementing interactive features, conducting unit testing with Jest, and managing tasks in GitHub.
en.projects-ita-challenges-repositories: Repositories: Frontend | Backend
en.projects-edumap-description: An application that allows users to visualize and analyze data related to access and equity in education through interactive maps. Data sourced from OpenData Barcelona allows users to explore indicators by district, such as household income and distribution of educational centers. This project was part of a hackathon at IT Academy, held on October 22, 2024, and involved a team of professionals in Data Analysis, Back-End, and Front-End disciplines.
en.projects-edumap-repositories: Repositories: Frontend | Backend
en.projects-trytime-description: Web application that generates random activities, designed for the IT Academy hackathon in 2024. Developed with Angular and Server-Side Rendering (SSR) to improve performance and SEO. TryTime allows users to fetch random activities from the Bored API, with filtering options by activity type. It includes network error handling, CORS optimization with proxy, and a responsive design adapted for mobile and desktop devices.

es.home-description: Frontend Developer en Angular con experiencia en entornos Agile. Enfocada en desarrollar aplicaciones escalables, robustas y accesibles, aplicando principios de UX. Integro IA como apoyo en el desarrollo y la productividad.
es.about-me-description-1: Desde 2016 trabajo en desarrollo web, evolucionando desde maquetación y frontend hasta aplicaciones modernas con Angular, TypeScript y arquitecturas escalables. Trabajo con Angular 16+, desarrollando componentes reutilizables, formularios dinámicos, gestión de estado con Angular Signals, integración de APIs REST, pruebas unitarias y mejoras de UX/UI en aplicaciones enterprise.
es.about-me-description-2: Tengo experiencia en mapeo de DTOs, asincronía con RxJS, testing y colaboración con Git Flow y Azure DevOps. Además, continúo profundizando en Angular moderno, arquitectura frontend y buenas prácticas de desarrollo.
es.about-me-description-3:
También sigo implementando mejoras y nuevas funcionalidades en mis proyectos personales para continuar evolucionando técnicamente:

• EZHub DS → Design System con Angular. Disponible en EZHub DS.

• EZHub → aplicación de búsqueda de habitaciones con geolocalización (Angular + NestJS + MySQL). Disponible en EZHub.
es.about-me-description-4: Actualmente busco nuevas oportunidades como Frontend Developer Angular, donde pueda aportar experiencia en desarrollo SPA, calidad de código y aprendizaje continuo.
